## Preconditions
Identify the `delivery_id`, `peer_request_id` (if any), bridge id, source/destination, lease, current retry count, and outage window. Do not manually replay with a new id.

## Procedure
1. Read the bridge envelope, local dedupe record, lease state, and last ACK. 2. For inbound data, verify authentication/scope, then lease and write the local record. ACK only after durable local write/readback; include record ref and durability mode. 3. For repeated inbound delivery, return the prior ACK and do not create another objective, ticket, room event, lease or external effect. 4. For outbound delivery, retry with the same `delivery_id` and `peer_request_id` using bounded exponential backoff. Keep local work independent of bridge availability. 5. After the retry bound, write a dead-letter record and one incident for the outage window. Do not mark the peer work complete. 6. When connectivity returns, inspect the dead-letter, read back local correlation, and re-drive only with the same idempotency key. Close the dead-letter only after peer ACK/report correlation is read back.

## Safety checks
A topic publication is not proof of peer work. An ACK is not a VP grant. Origin tags prevent re-egress loops. A bridge outage isolates federation only; local control, reports, tickets and workers continue.
